name: lotus eater
source:
hedonism turned self destruction 

i want to trick myself into thinking i love you 

and delude myself into thinking you love me back

[From [url=https://lovekrafts.itch.io/lotus-eater]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
縱情享樂成了自我毀滅。

我想哄騙自己，相信我愛你。

也想自欺欺人，相信你也愛我。
